description: User-reported exact battle-voice corrections that must override generic fragment translation.

entries.reason: The generic っ！！→윽！！ fragment translation is wrong inside the shouted name トビアっ！！. Treat the whole utterance as one exact phrase instead of composing 토비아 + 윽！！.

Runtime evidence proves the leading 86=全 is visible sentence text here, not battle metadata. The translated ext3 tail already contains the complete Korean line, so retaining 86 duplicates the first word as 全전.
Byte-identical duplicate of 5DC23D in the alternate battle-voice bank; apply the same screen-proven visible-lead correction so runtime routing cannot reintroduce 全전.
